verses.he: יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּסֵ֣תֶר עֶלְיֹ֑ון בְּצֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְלֹונָֽן׃
verses.ar: اَلسَّاكِنُ فِي سِتْرِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ، فِي ظِلِّ ٱلْقَدِيرِ يَبِيتُ.
verses.en: O thou that dwellest in the covert of the Most High, and abidest in the shadow of the Almighty;
verses.kjv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.web: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.he: אֹמַ֗ר לַֽ֭יהוָה מַחְסִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֑י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֶבְטַח־בֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: أَقُولُ لِلرَّبِّ: «مَلْجَإِي وَحِصْنِي. إِلَهِي فَأَتَّكِلُ عَلَيْهِ».
verses.en: I will say of the LORD, who is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust,
verses.kjv: I will say of the LORD, [He is] my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verses.web: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

verses.he: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּֽילְךָ מִפַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ מִדֶּ֥בֶר הַוֹּֽות׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ يُنَجِّيكَ مِنْ فَخِّ ٱلصَّيَّادِ وَمِنَ ٱلْوَبَإِ ٱلْخَطِرِ.
verses.en: That He will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.kjv: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, [and] from the noisome pestilence.
verses.web: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

verses.he: בְּאֶבְרָתֹ֨ו ׀ יָ֣סֶךְ לָ֭ךְ וְתַֽחַת־כְּנָפָ֣יו תֶּחְסֶ֑ה צִנָּ֖ה וְֽסֹחֵרָ֣ה אֲמִתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: بِخَوَافِيهِ يُظَلِّلُكَ، وَتَحْتَ أَجْنِحَتِهِ تَحْتَمِي. تُرْسٌ وَمِجَنٌّ حَقُّهُ.
verses.en: He will cover thee with His pinions, and under His wings shalt thou take refuge; His truth is a shield and a buckler.
verses.kjv: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth [shall be thy] shield and buckler.
verses.web: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

verses.he: לֹא־תִ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד לָ֑יְלָה מֵ֝חֵ֗ץ יָע֥וּף יֹומָֽם׃
verses.ar: لَا تَخْشَى مِنْ خَوْفِ ٱللَّيْلِ، وَلَا مِنْ سَهْمٍ يَطِيرُ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ،
verses.en: Thou shalt not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; [nor] for the arrow [that] flieth by day;
verses.web: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

verses.he: מִ֭דֶּבֶר בָּאֹ֣פֶל יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ מִ֝קֶּ֗טֶב יָשׁ֥וּד צָהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.ar: وَلَا مِنْ وَبَإٍ يَسْلُكُ فِي ٱلدُّجَى، وَلَا مِنْ هَلَاكٍ يُفْسِدُ فِي ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ.
verses.en: Of the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor of the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.kjv: [Nor] for the pestilence [that] walketh in darkness; [nor] for the destruction [that] wasteth at noonday.
verses.web: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

verses.he: יִפֹּ֤ל מִצִּדְּךָ֨ ׀ אֶ֗לֶף וּרְבָבָ֥ה מִימִינֶ֑ךָ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִגָּֽשׁ׃
verses.ar: يَسْقُطُ عَنْ جَانِبِكَ أَلْفٌ، وَرِبْوَاتٌ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ. إِلَيْكَ لَا يَقْرُبُ.
verses.en: A thousand may fall at Thy side, and ten thousand at Thy right hand; it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.kjv: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; [but] it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.web: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

verses.he: רַ֭ק בְּעֵינֶ֣יךָ תַבִּ֑יט וְשִׁלֻּמַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.ar: إِنَّمَا بِعَيْنَيْكَ تَنْظُرُ وَتَرَى مُجَازَاةَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ.
verses.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, and see the recompense of the wicked.
verses.kjv: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
verses.web: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

verses.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י עֶ֝לְיֹ֗ון שַׂ֣מְתָּ מְעֹונֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ قُلْتَ: «أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ مَلْجَإِي». جَعَلْتَ ٱلْعَلِيَّ مَسْكَنَكَ،
verses.en: For thou hast made the LORD who is my refuge, even the Most High, thy habitation.
verses.kjv: Because thou hast made the LORD, [which is] my refuge, [even] the most High, thy habitation;
verses.web: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

verses.he: לֹֽא־תְאֻנֶּ֣ה אֵלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝נֶ֗גַע לֹא־יִקְרַ֥ב בְּאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: لَا يُلَاقِيكَ شَرٌّ، وَلَا تَدْنُو ضَرْبَةٌ مِنْ خَيْمَتِكَ.
verses.en: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.
verses.kjv: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
verses.web: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ يُوصِي مَلَائِكَتَهُ بِكَ لِكَيْ يَحْفَظُوكَ فِي كُلِّ طُرُقِكَ.
verses.en: For He will give His angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.kjv: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.web: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

verses.ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَيْدِي يَحْمِلُونَكَ لِئَلَّا تَصْدِمَ بِحَجَرٍ رِجْلَكَ.
verses.en: They shall bear thee upon their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.kjv: They shall bear thee up in [their] hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.web: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

verses.he: עַל־שַׁ֣חַל וָפֶ֣תֶן תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְתַנִּֽין׃
verses.ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَسَدِ وَٱلصِّلِّ تَطَأُ. ٱلشِّبْلَ وَٱلثُّعْبَانَ تَدُوسُ.
verses.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and asp; the young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.web: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

verses.he: כִּ֤י בִ֣י חָ֭שַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗הוּ כִּֽי־יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽי׃
verses.ar: «لِأَنَّهُ تَعَلَّقَ بِي أُنَجِّيهِ. أُرَفِّعُهُ لِأَنَّهُ عَرَفَ ٱسْمِي.
verses.en: 'Because he hath set his love upon Me, therefore will I deliver him; I will set him on high, because he hath known My name.
verses.kjv: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.web: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

verses.he: יִקְרָאֵ֨נִי ׀ וְֽאֶעֱנֵ֗הוּ עִמֹּֽו־אָנֹכִ֥י בְצָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלְּצֵ֗הוּ וַֽאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ׃
verses.ar: يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ، مَعَهُ أَنَا فِي ٱلضِّيقِ، أُنْقِذُهُ وَأُمَجِّدُهُ.
verses.en: He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will rescue him, and bring him to honour.
verses.kjv: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I [will be] with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.web: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

verses.ar: مِنْ طُولِ ٱلْأَيَّامِ أُشْبِعُهُ، وَأُرِيهِ خَلَاصِي».
verses.en: With long life will I satisfy him, and make Him to behold My salvation.'
verses.kjv: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
verses.web: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
